title: Library Lockfile Schema
description: JSON Schema for .library.lock v2. Requested roots express intent; receipts record owned materializations. The installed array is a deprecated compatibility projection.

oneOf.description: Legacy v1 shape accepted for migration input.

requested_roots.description: The operator's direct artifact and Workspace intent.

receipts.description: Materialized artifacts with ownership and exact target evidence.

prerequisites.description: Non-owning external prerequisites such as MCP readiness checks.

installed.description: Deprecated read compatibility projection derived from receipts.

lockfile_entry.description: A single installed library item with full provenance metadata.

name.description: Unique name of the installed item. Must match the catalog entry name in library.yaml.

type.description: Primitive type of the installed item.

scope.description: Explicit installation scope. Absolute project targets do not imply global scope.

version.description: Catalog artifact version resolved at install time when declared.

catalog_identity.description: Stable identity of the library catalog that produced this install, normally its canonical repository URL. Optional only for legacy entries created before catalog provenance was recorded.

marketplace.description: Name of the source-provider marketplace entry in library.yaml.marketplaces. Identifies which marketplace this item was fetched from. Use 'local' for local-path sources and 'unknown' for sources that cannot be matched to a registered marketplace.

source.description: Origin URL or local path from which the item was fetched. For GitHub sources, this is the browser-form URL (https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/blob/<branch>/<path>). For local sources, the absolute or relative file path.

source_commit.description: Git commit SHA of the source repository at install time. Provides reproducibility: re-running /library sync with this SHA yields identical content. Use 'local' for non-git local sources.

cache_path.description: Absolute path to the Layer-B (cache) directory for this item, format: ~/.local/share/library/skills/<marketplace>/<name>@<first-14-hex-chars-of-source_commit>/. Set to empty string for entries migrated from older lockfile versions — will be populated on next 'library sync'.

install_target.description: Relative path of the installation directory within the project (e.g. .claude/skills/dolt/ for a project-local skill). Trailing slash is required.

install_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the item was installed or last refreshed.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the local installed content. For directory installs this is the Merkle-style hash of the vendored directory; for file installs this is the file hash. Kept as the backward-compatible audit field.

checksum_type.description: Checksum strategy used. 'file' (default) checksums the primary artifact only. 'directory' checksums all files in the installed directory (Merkle-style). Directory installs (skills, standards) use 'directory'; single-file installs (agents, prompts) use 'file'. Entries without this field are treated as unknown.

content_sha256.description: Explicit SHA-256 checksum of the local installed content at install_target. New vendor-mode entries set this to the same value as checksum_sha256.

install_mode.description: How Layer C was materialized. 'vendor' means real files were copied into the install target; 'symlink' means the install target points into the Layer-B cache.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the installed item (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, proprietary). Use 'unknown' when no license information is available.

bridge_symlinks.description: List of symlink bridges created during dual-install (per CL-b4o name-collision policy). Each string is a human-readable description of the form '<link-path> -> <target-path>'. Empty list means no bridge was created (single-harness install).

composed_layers.description: Composition metadata for agents installed with layered prompt composition (CL-08n). Present only when the agent was composed from an agent-base (Layer 1) and/or model-standard (Layer 3) files. Omit for non-composed installs.

agent_base.description: Layer 1 agent base prompt used during composition.

name.description: Name of the agent base prompt (matches the filename without .md).

sha.description: SHA-256 checksum of the agent base prompt file at compose time.

model_standards.description: Layer 3 model-standard files used during composition, in order.

name.description: Name of the model-standard (matches the filename without .md).

sha.description: SHA-256 checksum of the model-standard file at compose time.

composed_sha.description: SHA-256 of the fully composed agent body (after Layer 1 + Layer 2 + Layer 3 concatenation). Used for drift detection: if any layer file changes, this SHA changes and triggers re-composition on /library sync. Omit for non-composed installs.
